title: Equality of Picard base-change stalk finranks
statement: Let f:X\to S be flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let E be finite locally free [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf], let g:T\to S satisfy PicardUniversalRankMatch f E g [def-sc-picard-universal-rank-match], and let h:T\prime\to T, t\in T\prime, and F=E or F=E^\vee. Write p:X\times_S T\to T and q:X\times_S T\to X for the projections, and p\prime:(X\times_S T)\times_T T\prime\to T\prime and v:(X\times_S T)\times_T T\prime\to X\times_S T for the next two projections [def-pc-base-change]. Put P=h^*p_*q^*F and Q=p\prime_*v^*q^*F, and take their stalks [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] at t. Then Module.finrank over O_{T\prime,t} of P_t equals Module.finrank of Q_t. This asserts only equality of natural-number finranks, not finite generation, freeness or a linear equivalence.

proof.text: Apply universal rank matching at h(t) for the identity and at t for h, getting local ranks r and s. For each local fixed-rank witness, compare tensor pullback with the ordinary left-adjoint pullback, pull the fixed-rank frame back to the inverse-image open, and use the finite-locally-free stalk finrank theorem there. The additive stalk comparison for open restriction is semilinear over the inverse open-immersion stalk-ring map, hence preserves rank and finrank. This computes the source finrank as r and the composite-base-change direct-image finrank as s. Tensor-pullback composition, pushforward composition and the adjunction unit along the associativity isomorphism identify the iterated target with that composite direct image. Reuse the existing private restriction_stalk_smul theorem from Modules.RestrictionStalkExtensionIso through a proof-only import all; do not restate it or inverse_stalkMap_germ.

Intersect the inverse image of the identity witness open with the h witness open. If h(t) belongs to the image of the projection X times_S T to T, choose a point x above it. Mathlib Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback gives a point z of X times_S this intersection above the image of x in X and t. Canonical maps to the two reference fibre products and tensor-pullback composition transport both fixed-rank predicates to the same pulled-back E. Compute its stalk finrank at z twice using finiteLocallyFreeOfRank_stalk_finrank, giving r=s. Combine the source and target calculations. Reuse the existing private tensorRankComp theorem from PicardUniversalRankMatchConjunction through a proof-only import all to transport both ranks.

If h(t) does not belong to the proper projection image, its complement is an open neighbourhood. Every germ of the direct image at h(t) has a representative on a smaller open in that complement; its inverse image is empty and the module sheaf has singleton sections there by the empty-cover sheaf condition. Thus the stalk is subsingleton and its finrank is zero. Mathlib Scheme.Pullback.range_snd shows that t is outside the composite-base-change projection image as well, so its direct-image stalk also has finrank zero. The already computed local stalk finranks force r=0=s, finishing the comparison. Rank zero and empty test schemes need no additional hypotheses.

lean.statement:
theorem picardRankMatch_baseChange_stalk_finrank_eq {X S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] (g : T ⟶ S)
    (hR : PicardUniversalRankMatch f E g) {T' : Scheme.{u}} (h : T' ⟶ T)
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : F = E ∨ F = Modules.dual E) (t : T') :
    let P := (Modules.tensorPullback h).obj
      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd f g)).obj
        ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F))
    let Q := (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h)).obj
      ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h)).obj
        ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F))
    Module.finrank (T'.presheaf.stalk t) (P.presheaf.stalk t) =
      Module.finrank (T'.presheaf.stalk t) (Q.presheaf.stalk t)
